_why:
Fifty edges joining the DIRDs to the programme that commissioned them and the agency that released them.

The AAWSAP edges are split, and the split is the point. All 32 released PDFs were downloaded and scanned in full on 23 August 2026. **27 of them name the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program in their own text**, on the inside cover: 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program', with (b)(3):10 USC 424 redacted between. Those 27 are Tier 1 on the document's own word.

**Five do not name the programme anywhere in the document**: aneutronic-fusion-propulsion, high-frequency-gravitational-wave-communications, invisibility-cloaking, positron-aerospace-propulsion and pulsed-high-power-microwave-source-technology. Their edges are Tier 2 and say so, resting on the DIA's 9 January 2018 list to the Senate Armed Services Committee rather than on the document. A first pass that only read the first three pages found 13 of 32 and would have got this wrong in the other direction; scanning the whole document found 27.

Retrieval note: irp.fas.org/dia/aatip-list.pdf still returns HTTP 202 with an empty body, so the list is cited at fas.org/publication/aatip-list/, which resolves.
